podcast.body: Released in early 1996, this song became Dishwalla's one and only hit. It was not only an alternative hit but also reached number 15 on the Billboard Hot 100 singles chart, making it a Top 40 hit. The band has never been able to repeat this level of success with any subsequent singles. "Not only was it an alternative hit, but admitted all the way to number 15 on the Billboard Hot 100 singles chart."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Great Alt-Rock One-Hit Wonders of the 90s: Part 2
